question: Among the patients who have a normal platelet level, how many of them have other symptoms observed?
evidence: normal platelet level refers to PLT > 100 and PLT < 400; have other symptoms refers to Diagnosis is not null;
clarification: Count each distinct ID only once.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT > 100 AND T2.PLT < 400 AND NOT T1.Diagnosis IS NULL
gold0: SELECT COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT > 100 AND T2.PLT < 400 AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL

b.request: How many distinct patients have at least one Laboratory record with PLT > 100 and PLT < 400 and a non-null Diagnosis?
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400 AND p.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL

d.request: Among patients with PLT > 100 and PLT < 400 whose Diagnosis is not null, how many distinct IDs are there?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient AS p JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID WHERE l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400 AND p.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) AS patient_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.PLT > 100 AND l.PLT < 400 AND e.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL;
